detail.longDescription: Is AI here to help us or replace us? What do you think is the future of AI? View all responses Is AI here to help us or replace us? I am looking for jobs and the only offer that comes to me via email or LinkedIn is for training AI models. It promises $100/hr or even more. I discarded those emails and messages. I am not dumb to train AI models so that they can replace me. Yet, after getting endless rejection emails, I did apply to one of them.
